SELECT s.store_id, s.format, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.staff_purchase_flag,
 count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx,
 count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND (s.store_id>=900 OR f.staff_purchase_flag OR f.channel_code<>'ST' OR f.channel_id<>1)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3,4,5

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d2, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negq, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'

WITH f AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) all_net, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount END) nonstaff_net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc_all, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.receipt_id END) rc_ns, sum(f.quantity) units
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(returns_net) rn, sum(receipts) rc, sum(units_sold) u FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT f.store_id, f.all_net, f.nonstaff_net, r.nsbr, r.rn, f.rc_all, f.rc_ns, r.rc, f.units, r.u FROM f FULL JOIN r USING(store_id) ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 12

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ds, min(return_date), max(return_date),
 sum(CASE WHEN sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan,
 sum(CASE WHEN refund_net<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negref, sum(CASE WHEN quantity_returned<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negq,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_return_line_load) stg_n, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line) fs_n, (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load) stg_s

SELECT 
 sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned > f.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_over,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > f.net_amount + 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) amt_over,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.store_key <> f.store_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diff_store_key,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.vat_rate <> f.vat_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_diff,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned = f.quantity AND abs(r.refund_net - f.net_amount)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) full_ret_amt_mismatch,
 count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) rn, sum(f.net_amount) sold_of_returned, max(r.return_date - f.sale_date) maxlag,

SELECT s.format, f.staff_purchase_flag staff,
 sum(f.net_amount) sold_net, sum(r.refund_net) ret_net, round(100*sum(r.refund_net)/sum(f.net_amount),3) pct_val,
 sum(f.quantity) sold_units, sum(r.quantity_returned) ret_units, round(100.0*sum(r.quantity_returned)/sum(f.quantity),3) pct_units,
 sum(f.gross_amount) sold_gross, sum(r.refund_gross) ret_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY ROLLUP(s.format, f.staff_purchase_flag) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.refund_net - f.net_amount*r.quantity_returned/f.quantity) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prop_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.refund_net*(1+r.vat_rate) - r.refund_gross) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ret_vat_mismatch,
 (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate) - gross_amount) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22') sale_vat_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nomem
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'

SELECT s.format, count(*) lines_total, count(DISTINCT f.store_key) store_keys,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) out_of_version
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' GROUP BY 1

WITH p AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 2
)
SELECT p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, s.format AS store_format,
       ROUND(100 * SUM(r.refund_net) / SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS returned_share_pct
FROM p
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
WHERE s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_period, s.format
ORDER BY CASE s.format WHEN 'Small' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Large' THEN 3 END
